name: bowmark
description: The web as callable functions: search flights across several aggregators, price a part across retailers, and other tasks that only exist behind a live site. The agent reads a typed function library, writes a short script, and Bowmark runs it on the real sites. Bundles the bowmark skill and auto-wires the hosted MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: The web as callable functions: write a script, Bowmark runs it on the real sites.
interface.longDescription: Bowmark turns the interaction-gated web into a typed function library. The agent calls get_library to see what's callable, writes a short JavaScript script against it, and sends it to run. Bowmark executes it on the live sites in a sandbox and returns the result. One call fans out across several sites, dedupes and ranks; individual sites are callable directly when you want a specific one. Auto-wires the hosted MCP server at api.bowmark.ai/mcp. No API key required.
